recipe_text.title: Garlic Chicken & Broccoli Stir-fry (tweaked)
instructions: Slice chicken breast thinly and marinate with soy sauce 10 minutes.
Sauté garlic in oil, add chicken and cook until almost done.
Add broccoli and a splash of water; stir-fry 2–3 minutes.

recipe_feedback.notes: Added a bit of soy and sesame oil; turned out great!
